source.snippet: Using Kingswaysoft plugin v25.2 and sending rows from a database select to Salesforce via REST APIv2, Bulk API but with each select, the process gets stuck consistently at the same number of rows, around 800k-900k, after that the batches start going one row each. (2026-09-24)

problem_statement: Enterprise data teams running large-scale Salesforce bulk data loads via SSIS hit silent stalls at high row counts (~800k), causing pipelines to effectively halt — a production-critical issue with no clear diagnostic tooling.
target_segment: Data engineers and Salesforce admins at mid-to-large enterprises running ETL/ELT pipelines into Salesforce using SSIS and third-party connectors (e.g., KingswaySoft).
notes: Buyer signal: KingswaySoft plugin is a paid enterprise product (~$1k-5k/year), so this user is already in a paying context. The stall at 800k rows is a production blocker for enterprise data ops teams. Pain is concrete, time-sensitive, and recurring across Salesforce integrations. A monitoring/diagnostic layer or a managed Salesforce bulk-load service with retry intelligence and progress visibility could address this. Similar complaints exist across Salesforce developer forums.
